bio.lead: Based in Bologna, Italy, I operate at the intersection of Industry 4.0, Mechatronics, and Digital Ecosystems.
bio.p1: My professional journey is defined by a single obsession: Optimization. Whether it's a 3D manufacturing farm or a global e-commerce operation, I look for the friction points where human energy is wasted on repetitive tasks.
bio.p2: I leverage a rare vertical integration of skills. I can design a custom CAD optimization pipeline (DfAM) in the morning and architect a full-stack automation handler for Shopify APIs in the afternoon. This allows me to see the "Big Orbit" while managing the "Micro Moons" of daily operations.
bio.p3: Currently, I focus on helping specialized manufacturers and high-growth e-commerce founders scale without adding unnecessary headcount. I build the systems that make their growth sustainable.
